name: Writer suffix (sandboxed demo)
description: Appends -sandboxed to every writer's output folder at run time. Runs in a Web Worker: it sees only the config of a run.

descriptions.ru: Добавляет -sandboxed к папке вывода каждого Writer при запуске. Работает в Web Worker: видит только конфиг запуска.
descriptions.en: Appends -sandboxed to every writer's output folder at run time. Runs in a Web Worker: it sees only the config of a run.
